goal.objective: Make the OpenCode voice assistant reliably capture complete spoken requests on this laptop and stream dictation into the normal message composer in real time, without a separate review popup or automatic sending for microphone-button input. Resolve the known recognition-throughput, premature-cutoff, missing-word and safe-composer-integration blockers with verified implementation, not by deleting blocker labels. Preserve existing drafts/attachments, session routing, microphone placement after Ctrl+P commands, Ctrl+P voice settings, privacy/offline speech, cancellation and cleanup. Explicitly prompt the user with a test phrase and a ready/listening cue before any human speech test. Verify source, runtime loading and the actual user workflow separately; retain required approval gates for host/runtime changes, deployment, shared restart and publication.

plan.summary: Resolve the actual recognition and native-composer blockers, preserve the microphone/footer/settings work, and finish only after source, loaded-runtime and explicitly prompted speech acceptance agree.
completionCriteria: Microphone-button dictation streams into the normal OpenCode message composer while speaking, with no separate review popup and no automatic submission; Enter remains a deliberate user action.

Complete known phrases, including testing one two three and a short sentence, are recognized without the demonstrated early cutoff or omitted suffix in controlled acoustic and explicitly prompted human tests; measured recognition throughput is fast enough to avoid growing backlog on this laptop.

Streaming updates preserve pre-existing text and attachments, reconcile recognizer revisions without duplicate words, respect concurrent user edits, and never cross sessions or overwrite a different prompt/dialog.

The microphone remains at the right end after Ctrl+P commands when subagent status appears/disappears; settings remain in Ctrl+P, with loading/listening/processing/error feedback that reflects actual readiness.

Audio stays local/offline and in memory, buffers remain bounded, cancellation/unload/session changes release plugin-owned resources, and system audio defaults/security settings and unrelated work are preserved.

Relevant type/lint/unit/integration checks pass; runtime loading and real workflow checks are recorded separately; blockers are resolved by evidence rather than relabeled. Any host/deployment/shared-restart/publication action has its required explicit authority.

tasks.description: Implement the measured capture/decoder/model fix with bounded resources and no silent truncation; preserve source provenance and existing dependencies/settings unless an in-scope change is actually needed.
tasks.evidence: Completed opt-in source path: documented public context.options.recognitionBackend reaches AudioWorker spawn, existing offline wrapper, argparse worker selection and explicit Speech backend; ready handshake reports backend and refuses mismatch rather than silently reverting. Default remains Vosk. Added transport/TUI/CLI/wrapper tests for readiness queueing, invalid choices, mismatch and cleanup. Early ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY opt-out precedes native imports; actual Sherpa/Piper model loading under syscall trace produced no file-write attempts, connections, private HOME/XDG files, or stderr. Verified installed Piper ORT 1.31.1's documented environment suppression; Sherpa bundles ORT 1.28.2. Latest package check passes 29 TS + 38 Python tests, strict types and lint; shell syntax passes. Previous 39-case native synthetic worker and maintained phrase/pause/noise smoke remain valid. Source selection/setup is prepared, not applied; active venv/models/config unchanged. Physical/acoustic, prompted human and normal-composer outcomes remain pending.

tasks.description: Exercise actual worker/transport plus short reads, slow/cold decoder, partial/final suffixes, pauses, overload, cancellation and cleanup; prove the relevant negative regression fails without its fix.
tasks.evidence: Inspected and ran actual bounded-capture, worker, smoke and transport suites: 29 TS + 40 Python tests pass with strict SDK/Python types/lint. Coverage includes 128-byte device reads preserving all 32k bytes/routing, explicit overload refusal before prefix delivery, stalled-reader/unload cleanup, EOF failure, processed-audio vs slow wall clock, partial revisions, native buffered suffix and final flush. Two newly added deterministic decoder/finalizer session-race tests failed before the fix: stale partial published and old finalizer cleared the new session's listen. Atomic capture publication/current epoch+sequence checks now pass both. Native JSON-main regression with real Sherpa/Piper models, a deliberately delayed decode, cold readiness and epoch switch passed; generated complete phrase delivered only to epoch2. Shutdown left zero live owned children/feeders/worker threads, and external network refused. Physical I/O/lock path alone substituted; this is not acoustic/TUI acceptance. Existing isolated native-reset mutation also fails the behavioral suffix assertion.

tasks.description: Repeat controlled speaker-to-microphone acceptance with known phrases, timing/backlog and cleanup evidence, without submitting test messages or saving audio.
tasks.evidence: Controlled physical probe ran the actual production Worker.capture, bounded reader and Sherpa native model using the real echo-cancelled microphone. Held the existing exact microphone lock; played only in-memory Piper test audio through unchanged default output. Both known phrases matched exactly once; 28/36 partial events appeared during playback, first partials 1.138/1.016s after playback start. Decoder RTF 0.185/0.184 over 4.625/5.625s of actual captured PCM; no errors or growing backlog. Every owned capture thread/child and transient PipeWire node was cleaned up. Before/after default metadata and speaker/microphone volumes matched. Saved numerical results only in acoustic-result.json; no microphone recordings/transcripts or OpenCode submissions, no human speech request, no model install/config rollout/shared restart.

phases.verification: Source backend selection and matching readiness handshake are implemented without changing the default/live engine. Most importantly, both complete required phrases passed actual speaker-to-microphone capture at decoder RTF below 0.19 with streaming partials, resource cleanup, and unchanged system audio defaults/volumes. Evidence covers recognition implementation/regressions/controlled acoustics only: loaded replacement TUI, prompted human speech, composer/draft integration and final acceptance remain unfinished.
